statement: (n d : ℕ) (hd : d ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n) : d * (n / d) = n
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : d ∣ n := by
    have h₂ : d ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n := hd
    have h₃ : d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n ∧ d ∣ n ∧ Nat.Coprime d (n / d) := by
      simpa [properUnitaryDivisors] using h₂
    exact h₃.2.1
  
  have h₂ : d * (n / d) = n := by
    have h₃ : d ∣ n := h₁
    have h₄ : d * (n / d) = n := by
      apply Nat.mul_div_cancel' h₃
    exact h₄
  
  exact h₂
